failure_or_lesson: A single cleanup function can retry after a partial failure but cannot retain a receipt that one derived plane already completed. Separate Temporal activities preserve completed work while retrying only the failed plane.
goal: Coordinate retryable cleanup of selected derived Claim indexes after correction or quarantine on the chosen workflow engine.
notes: Local Temporal dev server is in-memory. Production persistence and full deletion influence traversal are not qualified.
procedure: Bind a metadata-only request to the exact XTDB head, run separate Qdrant and LadybugDB prune activities through Temporal, verify scope and head in each activity, retry failures without rerunning prior completed activities, and continue read-time authority filtering while cleanup lags.
validation: Real local Temporal server component test retried only a failed activity. Selected-backend run 36611170900 passed Temporal activity cleanup against XTDB, Qdrant, and LadybugDB. Server restart persistence remains open.
